status: DRAFT: pre-registration only; no code written, nothing run; needs explicit approval before any implementation
test: B4: out-of-core monolithic-equivalent 3-way solver (design note GTO_3WAY_NEXT_ARCHITECTURE_V2.md section 2.3)

basis.B3b: factorized trunk fed the exact monolithic frontier values is bit-identical to A' for 50 iterations; a stale-by-one oracle diverges at iteration 2 (b3b_verdict.json)
basis.B3a/D: frontier re-solve from scratch per trunk iteration (B) FAIL; any frontier state kept across iterations changes the algorithm unless it is the monolithic state itself
basis.consequence: the only no-accuracy-risk split is to keep the monolithic frontier regret/strategy state, just stored out of core

design.in_memory: trunk regrets + strategy sums (full node 46 Kc7d4h: 9.03 GB measured in B1)
design.on_disk: one file per (frontier template, instance block): f32 regrets + strategy sums, same layout as the in-memory arena slice (full: 12.4 GB, largest flop frontier 0.91 GB)
design.walk: unchanged player-major traversal of A (alternating) and A' (simultaneous); a frontier block is read before its subtree walk and written back after it, with no change in arithmetic or order
design.frontier_major_variant: three per-player walks while a block is resident: registered separately, for A' only; not part of the first acceptance

acceptance_fixed_before_implementation.T1_reduced_identity: reduced node-46 game (Kc7d4h; turns 2s/Qh/8c; rivers 3d/Js/6h; M2): out-of-core vs in-memory A and A' for 50 iterations; trunk and frontier regret / strategy-sum / root value max abs diff == 0 at every iteration (same arithmetic and order, so tolerance 0)
acceptance_fixed_before_implementation.T1_negative_control: skip the write-back of one frontier block at one iteration: must diverge (first divergence reported); otherwise T1 is invalid
acceptance_fixed_before_implementation.T2_resume: kill the process mid-iteration (inside a frontier block) and resume from the on-disk state + trunk checkpoint: bit-identical to the uninterrupted run at iteration 50
acceptance_fixed_before_implementation.T3_full_one_iteration: full node 46 Kc7d4h, one alternating iteration: peak RSS <= 12 GB goal, >= 15 GB hard stop (abort); record wall time, CPU time, bytes read/written, disk use; disk free must exceed state size + 20%
acceptance_fixed_before_implementation.T4_budget: 100 full iterations only after T1-T3 pass AND a separate approval; per-iteration checkpoint; exploitability measured with the exact evaluator at 50 and 100

measured_resources_at_draft.note: 28 GB avail vs 12.4 GB frontier state: feasible, but leaves room for one state copy only

not_allowed: no sparse allocation / MCCFR / river on-demand in this test
results are a research solve of one flop, not 'GTO' for node 46
ranking_caveat: 46/246 rank first by reach x proxy |delta| (final_census.json); the |delta| is an untested HU-to-3-way transfer proxy
